name: skill-tuning
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Retunes a handful of stock skills: longer Blessing, a wider Arrow Shower, faster bolts, a longer Monk combo window, a harder-hitting Bash. A worked example of changing skills from a mod.

settings.label: Faster Fire Bolt and Cold Bolt
settings.description: Cuts both bolts' cast time by a fifth (and halves their fixed cast in renewal).

settings.label: Longer Monk combo window
settings.description: Gives Triple Attack, Chain Combo and Combo Finish 300 ms more delay, which is also 300 ms more time to press the next combo skill.

settings.label: Extra Bash damage (%)
settings.description: Bash deals this much more damage than stock. 0 leaves its damage alone.

settings.label: Cold Bolt can freeze
settings.description: Each Cold Bolt cast that deals damage has a 5% chance to freeze its target.

settings.label: Log every hook call
settings.description: Writes each Lua hook call to the map server's log. For checking the mod works; leave it off.
